name: Iron Horse Golf Course
_comment_tees: Scorecard from GolfPass (its pars and handicaps match OpenStreetMap's hole tags). Its ratings table names older tees, each about 65 yd shorter than the card's: Black and Green match by name; White (5,713) is the card's Blue and Front (5,083) its Silver. Horse Track and Red have no rating, so they are left out.
_comment_shift: OSM outlines sit this many metres off the Esri imagery (measured by fitting all bunkers to the sand); every point is moved by it.
_comment_drop: Polygons containing these points are not part of the course (two practice greens).
